_comment: Repositories and owners excluded from the directory. This is the mechanism
behind the takedown promise made on /licensing, /data, /badge, in the site
footer and in the README. Without it a hand-deleted entry silently returns on
the next nightly refresh, because every run rebuilds from the GitHub API.
An entry here is removed from the JSON, the CSV, the sitemap, /mcp, and every
page; its /servers/<id> URL then 404s. Exclusion is re-applied on every run,
so it holds permanently rather than until the next crawl.
Add an id to remove one repository. Add an owner to remove every repository
from that account -- an erasure request covers the handle, which is the only
personal data this directory republishes. Keep `reason` and `date` filled in:
this file is the record of why something was removed, and it is the first
thing to read if the same repo is ever proposed for re-listing.
See docs/OPERATIONS.md, section 'Honouring a takedown request'.
